purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Kilifi North Form 34B and preserve a genuine source-availability gap without promotion.

sample.review_context_note: The official IEBC Form 34B download for form_id 277639 (constituency_code 11 + 277628) was independently re-downloaded twice in separate curl sessions (each preceded by the governed home-page + set-election=5 handshake) and both attempts produced byte-identical output (same sha256, 290,787 bytes). The resulting PDF has exactly one page. Rendered at 250 DPI, that single page is clearly labelled in its own footer 'Page 4 of 4' and its content is the FORM 34B 'Agent of Candidates (if Present)' handing-over/taking-over signature block for CON.011 -- not the polling-station results table or the constituency TOTAL row.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5). The download was independently repeated a second time in a fresh curl session and produced an identical sha256, ruling out a transient truncation. The form_id was separately cross-checked against a live re-discovery of the official portal's own manifest (scripts/p23/discover-iebc-form34b-manifest.py), which returned 277639 as the sole download_id and view_id for the KILIFI NORTH row (portal_row_id 61, form_status 'reported'), confirming there is no alternate or additional download reference available for this constituency's Form 34B on the portal.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Not applicable -- no TOTAL row or polling-station results table is present anywhere in the official portal PDF for this constituency.

note: The official IEBC portal's own download reference for Kilifi North (form_id 277639, independently re-confirmed as the sole download/view id for this constituency via a fresh run of scripts/p23/discover-iebc-form34b-manifest.py) serves a PDF containing only a single page: the Form 34B 'Agent of Candidates' handing-over/taking-over signature page, printed in its own footer as 'Page 4 of 4'. Pages 1-3, which would contain the polling-station results table and the constituency TOTAL row (registered voters, the four presidential candidate totals, rejected ballots and total valid votes), are simply not present in the file the portal serves. Re-downloading in a second, independent curl session produced a byte-identical file (same sha256), ruling out a one-off network truncation. This is a genuine official-source availability gap, not a misread or a transcription question, so no field can be visually source-verified and no turnout observation may be promoted for this constituency from this evidence. Recorded as verification_state=source_unreadable per the extraction contract's allowed row_verification_states; left unresolved rather than inferring or estimating any value.
